summary: Describes YANG data models for configuring and managing DHCPv6 servers, relays, and clients, building on the DHCPv6 protocol in RFC 8415. A YANG model lets network management tools set up and monitor these components in a consistent, machine-readable way. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: DHCPv6 hands out network addresses, a bit like a hotel desk handing out room keys. This gives the managers one standard form to set up and check the desk, no matter who made the software.

questions: how to configure dhcpv6 with netconf
